environment: Codex in-app browser at localhost:5173; normal admin2 login; isolated fictional database through localhost:3101
method: Real browser UI interactions and visible DOM/screenshot observations using cua_repl

checks.name: Accounting navigation and initial report
checks.observed: New Admin opens Accounting with All dates and 162 bill lines. Summary: $16,185 billed, $8,001 paid, $0 credit applied, $8,184 open.

checks.name: Open bills and balance sorting
checks.observed: Open bills selects 82 lines including the $84 partially paid line; ascending Open sort places it before $100 open lines.

checks.name: Bill history
checks.observed: Bill line 162 displays $85 billed, $1 paid, $84 open, and cash receipt/application timestamps for payment 81.

checks.name: Combined person/class filtering
checks.observed: Casey Rivera member 2 plus class 37 returns one matching $100 bill line, line 161.

checks.name: Search picker loading
checks.observed: All people label is correct and stale search options are hidden behind Searching status before updated results arrive.

checks.name: Date presets and empty state
checks.observed: Last month resolves to October 1–31 in America/New_York and shows zero matching bills with a clear-filters action.

checks.name: Custom date validation
checks.observed: Native keyboard editing sets From to December 1 and Through to November 30; an alert explains that From must be on or before Through and report/export are unavailable.

checks.name: Payment-date selection
checks.observed: Payment received date plus This month selects 81 lines; copy explains that current lifetime balances include later reversals.

checks.name: CSV export
checks.observed: Exporting that filtered report displays Filtered CSV exported. Response headers, formatting, filters, safety, and limits are verified separately by API and automated tests.

checks.name: Payment overview
checks.observed: 101 events show $9,001 receipts, $500 refunds, $8,501 net cash, $8,001 applied, and $500 unapplied.

checks.name: Receipt allocation and refund detail
checks.observed: Payment 80 displays a $125 receipt, its $100 class allocation with timestamps, and a $25 succeeded refund with recorded date.

checks.name: Refund-only view
checks.observed: 20 refund events show $0 receipts, $500 refunds, and -$500 net cash.

checks.name: Person attribution
checks.observed: Casey Rivera member 2 displays $201 whole household receipts separately from $101 applied to matching bills, across two events.

checks.name: Account drilldown and return
checks.observed: Payment 1 opens Rivera Family 001 in Billing. Returning to Accounting retains Payments view and Casey Rivera selection, with freshly loaded values.

checks.name: Pagination
checks.observed: Next shows page 2 of 7 with 162 total records; reset returns the all-dates first page.

checks.name: Responsive visual review
checks.observed: Reviewed desktop filters, four summary cards, readable table, and narrow stacked layout. DOM viewport/document widths matched at 1440 and 390 pixels; no document horizontal overflow. Temporary viewport override reset.

console: No captured browser errors. One earlier framer-motion position warning predates the accounting verification.
finalState: Accounting / Bills & line items, all dates and reset filters; existing browser tab retained. No financial actions performed.
